title: Remove Admin Accounts tab and manage order-linked accounts from Orders UI

requirements.summary: Remove the standalone Admin “Accounts” tab/section (and related lazy imports) and update admin dashboard copy to reflect the new UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel no longer shows an “Accounts” tab/section.
No unused/lazy imports remain for the removed Accounts section (e.g., AdminAccountsSection).
Admin Panel header/description text is updated so it does not claim admins manage accounts from the dashboard if the accounts area was removed.

file_operations.description: Remove the Accounts tab trigger and tab content from the Admin Panel UI, and delete the related lazy import(s) (e.g., AdminAccountsSection). Update the Admin Dashboard header/description text so it no longer advertises a separate accounts area.
Delete the standalone Admin Accounts section UI component so it cannot be navigated to from the admin tabs and does not leave dead code behind.
Remove any accounts-list-specific query keys that are now unused by the UI after deleting the standalone Accounts section (keep/add only keys needed for order-linked account status).

requirements.summary: Add per-order account management controls in the admin Orders UI to view owner status and ban/unban or grant/revoke VIP for the owner principal.
acceptanceCriteria: For any order that has an owner principal, the admin UI exposes controls to: (1) ban/unban the owner, and (2) grant/revoke VIP for the owner, without navigating to a separate Accounts page.
If an order has no owner (owner is null), the UI clearly indicates that account management is unavailable for that order and does not show broken controls.
After a ban/unban or VIP change, the UI refreshes to reflect the updated account status and does not require a manual page reload.
User-facing text for these controls and confirmations is in English.

file_operations.description: Add a targeted account-status query key (e.g., accountKeys.info(principalText)) to support fetching/updating account status per order owner without relying on a full accounts list.

Refactor admin account hooks to support targeted order-linked account management: add a React Query hook that fetches account status for a single Principal using the backend function typed as getAccountInfo(user). Ensure VIP/ban mutations invalidate the targeted account-status query key (and other relevant keys) so the UI refreshes automatically. Use the selected "authorization" component patterns for handling authorization failures gracefully on the frontend; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an admin-only UI component to be embedded in each order card that: (1) shows current account status for the order owner (VIP/banned/orderCount/profile name/email when present), (2) provides ban/unban and grant/revoke VIP controls with English confirmation dialogs, and (3) renders a clear disabled/unavailable state when order.owner is missing. Use existing shadcn-ui composed components (e.g., Card/Badge/Button/AlertDialog) for consistent styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new per-order account management component into the Orders tab UI for each order row/card. When an order has no owner, show a clear message (e.g., 'No owner on this order; account management unavailable') and do not render action buttons. Ensure successful mutations trigger a status refresh via React Query invalidation (no manual reload needed).
